answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 30 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the plume stamp is verified against the copper nonce, the atlas audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus burns the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 471 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
